target: Joint annual pitfall encounter histories in supplied blocks; not certain absences or verified occupancy.
inference: No incremental held-block gain for these two water proxies beyond fixed terrestrial habitat and observation process.
limitations: Static latent state across1995-2016 and conditional independence of annual encounters are assumptions.
Targeted survey locations, mixed covariate dates and incomplete water inventories limit biological inference.
Changes of data, predictors, likelihood and folds prevent attributing the contrast with presence-only solely to effort.
No source-cell coordinates, geometric-gap validation, climate extraction or hindcast correction.
